context: the README of an R package that fits birth-death models of species diversification to phylogenetic trees of living species

figures.name: hidden
figures.claim: A phylogeny of living species records only the survivors of a history that also contained many extinct lineages; the package proposes those hidden extinct lineages onto the observed tree, and one such draw resembles the true history.
must: the middle tree is the observed data and contains no extinct lineages
the left tree is the true history, with extinct lineages (in purple) that the data omit
the right tree is the observed tree with extinct lineages added by the method, comparable in number to the true ones

figures.name: path
figures.claim: On a tree simulated with an effect of D on speciation, the covariate path lets D enter first, its coefficient reaches the true value of -0.4, and BIC keeps D alone while N, ED and K stay at zero.
must: D is the first covariate to enter the path
at the BIC choice D's coefficient is near the true -0.4
N, ED and K are zero at the chosen point and only move at the very end of the path
